name: Neural Volume Scene Setup
aliases: Mitsuba Scene Construction for Neural Volumes
definition: Constructs a Mitsuba scene containing a volumetric cube and a custom neural radiance field integrator, initializing the density grid and spherical harmonics coefficients.
summary: Neural Volume Scene Setup constructs a Mitsuba scene graph binding neural network parameters to volume components, enabling end-to-end gradient flow for differentiable volume rendering.
